function.name: SceneResource_ModeNoOpHook
function.body: The complete function body is one RTS instruction and preserves all caller state.
call_sites: Interaction_UpdateResourceState selects SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE=0x1C, calls the hook, then clears its status byte.
Interaction_UpdateResourceState selects SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE=0x1B, calls the hook, then clears its status byte.
Hud_RunPendingDisplayPresentation selects SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE=0x04, calls the hook, then starts its presentation service.
function.effect: No memory, register, control-flow, or return-value effect beyond the call/return boundary.

conclusion: This is an intentional RTS-only scene-resource mode hook. The mode-specific work is performed by the callers and by SceneResource_InstantiateActors or the presentation service that follows; no additional behavior is assigned to this address.
